thought.text: Let me test the authenticated admin area (the secure routes) and the public application flow.

reasoning_content: Admin secure routes exist. Let me test the authenticated admin page, e.g. /en/admin/users, and check the seeded super admin credentials for the web app. Also test the public club application page. Let me do a real authenticated request to admin/users with the session cookie.

action.command: cd /tmp; echo "=== authenticated /en/admin/users ==="; curl -s -b naj.txt -m 40 -o /tmp/users.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} url=%{url_effective}\n" -L http://localhost:3000/en/admin/users; grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/users.html | head; grep -oiE 'Jane Doe|users|list' /tmp/users.html | sort | uniq -c | head; echo "=== unauthenticated /en/admin/users (expect redirect) ==="; curl -s -m 30 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" http://localhost:3000/en/admin/users
